name: How do I choose the right baseboard height and style for my home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right baseboard height and style for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceiling height and overall room proportions are the main decision factors. In homes with standard eight-foot ceilings, baseboards typically range from 3-1/4 inches to 5-1/4 inches tall. If you have nine- or ten-foot ceilings, taller profiles measuring 5-1/4 to 7 inches create balanced visual weight and keep the molding from looking lost. You should also match the architectural style of your home: flat, square-edge baseboards fit modern designs, while stepped or colonial profiles complement traditional spaces. Also ensure the baseboard thickness matches your existing door casing so seams stay flush.
acceptedAnswer.description: Match baseboard height to your ceiling height: 3 to 5 inches for 8-foot ceilings, and 5 to 7 inches for taller ceilings. Match the style and thickness to your door casings.
